name: ielts-vocabulary-coach
title_zh: 雅思单词讲到能直接用进写作口语的陪练
tagline_zh: 背了三千词，写作还是挤牙膏？它把每个词讲到搭配、语境、写作例句，让你真敢在考场上用出来。
tagline_en: Tired of words that never make it into your essay? It drills collocations and usage until you can actually deploy.
desc_en: Explain English vocabulary for IELTS learners in depth, especially when the user asks to memorize a word, learn IELTS vocabulary, or provides one or more words for usage, collocations, writing, or speaking.
why_zh: 不满足于给释义，它按雅思写作口语的真实场景拆解用法，逼你从「认识」跨到「会用」这一格。
why_en: It doesn't stop at definitions—it breaks down real IELTS writing/speaking usage, pushing you from recognition to active command.
limit_zh: 只覆盖雅思学术类词汇的用法讲解，不生成练习题、不批改作文、不教发音；需要你主动给出单词或提出记忆请求才启动。
limit_en: Covers IELTS academic vocab usage only—no quizzes, essay grading, or pronunciation. Requires you to supply words or ask to memorize first.
title_en: IELTS vocab coach that gets words into your writing
